messages:
sarah: Heads up — Sales wants to push DataStreamX POC next week but their CAIQ answers are missing a few things. I uploaded the vendor CAIQ PDF to the drive: https://redwood.drive/dsxcaiq
matt: Which sections are blank/missing? can you paste the gaps here?

sarah: Major gaps: Encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM usage, key ownership, network isolation for POC, attestation for pentest/SOC2 timeline. They marked several items as 'refer to docs' but link is internal to them (not shared).
jordan: For encryption-at-rest we usually ask for: algorithm, KMS provider, customer key bring-your-own-key (BYOK) support, envelope encryption flow, and whether DB snapshots/backups are encrypted. Also ask for key rotation policy and access controls (IAM roles).

alex: POC networking: we need a clear ask for IP allowlist, VPC peering vs. private endpoint, and data egress policy. Sales expects a quick answer so we can set up non-prod data pull.
david: Also need proof of recent pen test and remediation timeline. If they haven't done SOC2, ask for compensating controls. Also query subprocessors and DPA (data processing agreement) — enterprise legal will push on that.

matt: Suggest we send a single follow-up email with a short prioritized checklist (encryption, keys, pentest/SOC2, network/access) and a sample stub for the POC network config we can provision. i'll draft.
sarah: 👍 please include a request for an architecture diagram that shows where customer data flows and where keys are stored.

sec-bot: Automated checklist reminder: include CAIQ control IDs when requesting clarifications (e.g., encryption: SC-13/SC-28 equivalents). See internal playbook: https://redwood.playbooks/vendor-security

jordan: Also call out retention and deletion for POC datasets. We only send pseudonymized test data for now — vendor must confirm deletion after 14 days and provide deletion confirmation.

matt: Drafted email below — can someone sanity-check before I send? If OK i'll cc sales and legal.

matt: ```
Hi DataStreamX team,

Thanks for the CAIQ. To move the POC forward we need short clarifications on a few high-priority items:

1) Encryption at rest & keys
   - Confirm algorithms used (AES-256, etc.) and whether backups/snapshots are encrypted.
   - Do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK)? If yes, describe KMS/HSM provider and the envelope encryption flow.
   - Key rotation policy and how key access is audited.

2) Network & POC access
   - We will provision a non-prod dataset. Provide options for connectivity: IP allowlist, VPC Peering, or private endpoint. If IP allowlist, provide public egress IP ranges.
   - Confirm whether the POC environment is tenant-isolated and whether cross-tenant access is possible.

3) Attestations & testing
   - Date of last pentest and remediation summary.
   - SOC2 status and report availability. If SOC2 is not complete, list compensating controls.

4) Data handling & deletion
   - Retention policy for POC data and deletion confirmation process (we require deletion confirmation within 14 days post-POC).

5) Subprocessors & DPA
   - Full subprocessors list for US/EU and any cross-border transfers.

Please attach an architecture diagram showing data flows and key locations. We’d like responses by EOD Friday to keep the POC timeline. If anything requires a live call we can set one up this week.

Thanks,
Matt (on behalf of Redwood Sales)
```

alex: Looks good. For the POC network snippet, add this allowlist example so they can test quickly:

alex: ```
# Redwood POC allowlist example
allowed_ips:
  - 34.75.12.45/32
  - 34.75.12.46/32
ports: [443]
notes: Only for non-prod dataset; restrict access to our infra account.```

sarah: One more ask — require KMS audit logs for key access exported to our SIEM for the POC (read-only). Add that as an optional bullet so we can escalate if they refuse.

david: Legal will want subprocessors + DPA before any prod access, but for POC we can do a limited DPA addendum. i'll message legal now so they're aware of the timeline.

matt: Thanks all — i'll send the email after adding KMS audit log bullet and cc sales/legal. action items:
- matt: send follow-up to DataStreamX (due: today)
- sarah: prepare sample pseudonymized dataset and redaction checklist (due: tomorrow)
- alex: prep allowlist/ip block for POC infra (due: tomorrow)
- david: flag legal for DPA/terms (due: today)

sarah: Thanks — will post results here when vendor responds. :thumbsup:
